# Checkbox

Checkbox — single boolean control with optional indeterminate state. Supports controlled (`isChecked`) and uncontrolled (`defaultChecked`) usage. Built on Base UI's Checkbox: a `role="checkbox"` span with a hidden native input beside it for form submission, wrapped in `FieldFrame` (A7) for the label and the description caption. `isInvalid` marks the unselected box only, through `data-invalid` scoped off `data-checked` in the stylesheet.

Also asked as: multi-select, checklist, tick box.

**Import:** `import { Checkbox } from '@/components';`

## Usage

Use a checkbox when a person needs to select one or more options from a list of related items, or when a setting needs an explicit confirmation before it applies, such as accepting terms or saving a form. A group of checkboxes lets a person choose many options, or none, from a short list they can see whole; a long list goes in a `Select` with `isMulti`.

Individual checkboxes have two states, selected and unselected. When checkboxes are grouped, a parent shows a third, mixed state while some, not all, of its children are selected.

## Best practices

### Say what is being agreed to. {#say-what-is-being-agreed-to}

The label states the commitment in a full phrase. "Yes" or "OK" hides what the person is accepting.

Do: The label names the agreement.
Don't: The label says nothing about what is accepted.

### Keep the label beside the box, in sentence case. {#keep-the-label-beside-the-box-in-sentence-case}

Sentence case reads as a statement. All caps and a trailing period read as a warning.

Do: Sentence case, no period.
Don't: All caps with a period.

### Keep each label to one line. {#keep-each-label-to-one-line}

A short label sits level with the box. A long one wraps and pushes the box away from its first line.

Do: One short line.
Don't: A label that wraps into a paragraph.

### Name the choice, not the instruction. {#name-the-choice-not-the-instruction}

Do: The label names the choice.
Don't: The label tells the person what to do with the box.

### Explain an invalid box; do not disable it. {#explain-an-invalid-box-do-not-disable-it}

Do: The invalid box keeps full contrast and stays in the tab order.
Don't: A disabled box cannot be tabbed to.

### Read-only is not disabled. {#read-only-is-not-disabled}

`isReadOnly` shows an answer the person may read but not change: the box stays in the tab order at full contrast, says `aria-readonly`, and ignores clicks and Space. `isDisabled` takes it out of the tab order and grays it, for a box that does not apply right now.

### A description describes; the label names. {#a-description-describes-the-label-names}

`description` renders under the label and is wired with `aria-describedby`, so it is read after the name instead of becoming part of it.

### Pick controlled or uncontrolled and stay there. {#pick-controlled-or-uncontrolled-and-stay-there}

```jsx
// Incorrect: `isChecked` being defined puts the component in controlled mode,
// which makes `defaultChecked` dead. The two never apply together.
<Checkbox id="terms" label="I accept" isChecked={accepted} defaultChecked />

// Correct: controlled needs a handler; uncontrolled needs neither.
<Checkbox id="terms" label="I accept" isChecked={accepted} onChange={onAccept} />
```

### `isIndeterminate` is display only. {#isindeterminate-is-display-only}

The underlying value is still checked or unchecked. Clicking a mixed box resolves it like any other, so it cannot be used as a third stored value.

## Accessibility

- **The label is wired for you, `id` or no `id`.** The component derives an id and hands it to the input and the label, so a caller who passes neither `id` nor `name` still gets a label that names the input.
- **A checkbox with no `label` has no accessible name.** Where the design has no room for visible text, pass `aria-label`; it is spread onto the input.
- **Do not disable a box that must stay reachable.** Use `isInvalid` with a message linked by `aria-describedby`, so a screen reader user hears why the option cannot be chosen.
- **Include an error message for a required or invalid box**, for example "Select an option".
- **`isRequired` reaches the input**, so native validation applies. The marker is decoration, hidden from assistive technology.
- **`isIndeterminate` is set on the DOM node**, the only way to express it. Screen readers report it as "mixed".
- **Keyboard focus is a 2px ring on `border.focused`, 2px off the box.** A pointer focus draws none. Space toggles the box; Enter does not.
- **Group related boxes** in a Fieldset with a `legend`: a Checkbox group.

## Related

- To turn a setting on or off at once, use Toggle.
- For one answer from several options, use Radio, or Radio group for the whole set.
- For a group of checkboxes, use a Checkbox group: Checkboxes inside a Fieldset with a legend.
- For a rows-by-columns matrix of choices, use Choice grid.
- For choices in a popup, use Select.

## Parts

1. **Box.** An 18 square with a 2px edge. Selected, it fills with the selected bold fill and draws a check; mixed, it draws a dash.
2. **Label.** 14/20 text beside the box in a 24 row. It names the checkbox. A required marker follows it.
3. **Description.** Optional 12/16 text under the label that describes the choice. It does not name it.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | `--ds-background-input` fill with a `--ds-border-input` edge. |
| Hovered | Unselected: `--ds-background-input-hovered` with a `--ds-border-brand` edge. Selected: the hovered step of the selected bold fill. |
| Focused | A 2px ring in `--ds-border-focused`, 2px off the box, for keyboard focus only. |
| Selected | `--ds-background-selected-bold` fill and `--ds-border-selected` edge; the check is `--ds-icon-inverse`. |
| Mixed | The same fill and edge as selected; the mark is a dash in `--ds-icon-inverse`. |
| Invalid | The unselected box takes `--ds-border-danger`. A selected or mixed box keeps its fill. |
| Read-only | Full contrast, in the tab order, `aria-readonly`; ignores clicks and Space. |
| Disabled | `--ds-background-disabled` fill, `--ds-border-disabled` edge, `--ds-icon-disabled` mark. Out of the tab order. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Box fill | `--ds-background-input`; selected `--ds-background-selected-bold`. |
| Box edge | `--ds-border-input`; selected `--ds-border-selected`; invalid `--ds-border-danger`. |
| Box size, radius | `--checkbox-control-size` (18); `--radius-025`; `--stroke-2` edge. |
| Row | `--item-height-sm` (24); gap `--space-050`. |
| Label | `--ds-text`, body default. |
| Focus ring | `--ds-border-focused`, 2px, 2px offset. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Write the label as the choice: "Email me a summary". | An instruction: "Check this box to receive an email summary." |
| Use sentence case and no end punctuation. | Title case, or a period after the label. |
| Phrase every label in the positive: "Send reminders". | A negative that makes selecting mean "no": "Do not send reminders". |
| Say what to do in an error: "Select an option". | "Required" or "Invalid". |
| Put extra detail in the description: "Sent the evening before." | Stretch the label into a sentence. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `id` | string | — | The `id` of the checkbox; the label points at it. Generated when omitted. |
| `name` | string | — | The form key the box submits under, and sent in the `onChange` payload. |
| `label` | node | — | Text that names the checkbox |
| `value` | string or number | — | The value submitted with a form when the box is selected, and sent in the `onChange` payload. |
| `isChecked` | bool | — | Whether the box is selected. Pass it, with `onChange`, to control the checkbox. |
| `defaultChecked` | bool | — | Whether the box starts selected, when `isChecked` is not controlling it. |
| `isIndeterminate` | bool | `false` | Mixed state, for a parent of partly selected children |
| `isInvalid` | bool | `false` | Marks the unselected box as failing validation |
| `isDisabled` | bool | `false` | Disable the checkbox |
| `isReadOnly` | bool | `false` | Shown and announced, not changeable |
| `isRequired` | bool | `false` | Show the required marker and require it natively |
| `description` | node | — | Secondary text under the label. It describes the box and does not name it. |
| `appearance` | enum | `'plain'` | `plain` (default) draws the box and label inline; `card` draws the choice as a bordered tile. |
| `onChange` | func | — | Called with `{ target: { name, value, checked } }` when the box is toggled. |
| `onFocus` | func | — | Called with the focus event when the checkbox gains focus. |
| `onBlur` | func | — | Called with the blur event when the checkbox loses focus. |
| `onClick` | func | — | Called with the click event on the checkbox. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class names added to the field wrapper beside the component's own. |
| `style` | object | — | Inline styles for the field wrapper. |
| `testId` | string | — | Maps to `data-testid`, for test queries. |

## Variants

**`appearance`** — `plain` · `card`

The named string values each prop takes. A prop's full type is in Props: a prop listed here may also take a boolean or a number, and a prop missing here may still have named values.
